arguments.name: push_drop
arguments.source:
w = window("push_local_mps", 140)
recent = mean(w[-20:])
before = mean(w[:-20])
recent - before
arguments.description: local push last 20 s minus the 2 min before

arguments.message: local push fell sharply within a leg: weed, drag or pod drift?
boat-model power vs pod power moved away from about 0.68: pod drift, drag or current change?

arguments.text: 6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m. Pacer sets effort. My job: (1) catch weed (push_local drop within a leg, recovers after clear_rudder), (2) catch pod drift (pod power moves but HR and GPS speed do not; eff_ratio = boat power / pod power, start ~0.68; w_per_beat), fix with pod_gain belief, (3) handle radio course changes with set_race_distance + tell, (4) answer paddler talk. Check legs() and measure() each wake; compare same-direction legs. Do not waste cues.
t=61s: start hard, pod 199 W vs CP 167; boat 136 vs 110; eff_ratio ~0.67-0.68; HR 129->149 rising (start). push_along +0.23 on leg 1 (north). Watches set: push_drop_mine, eff_shift.

text: no cue: early race, set watches and plan
no cue: early race, watches and plan set, nothing to correct yet

arguments.text: t=240s: pacer eased at 110 s. Now pod 167 W = CP test value, HR 165-166 levelling, pod reserve 70 %, boat reserve 56 % (boat model reads effort relatively higher, eff_ratio ~0.70). Watch HR at ~CP: if it keeps climbing, true CP lower than 167; if flat, CP may be higher (unspent reserve risk).

text: no cue: alert was the turn flipping the current, not weed

arguments.text: t=556s leg 2 (south): at ~530 s GPS speed fell 2.88->2.76 and push_local -0.21->-0.31 with pod steady 170 W, rate 60, HR 168 steady. So not effort: drag (weed) or current/wind change. Pacer clear_rudder rule should fire (drop>0.06). Check: if speed recovers after a back-stroke -> weed. Leg 1 north push_local was +0.29: compare leg 3.

Plan: at ~680 s compare leg-3 push_local with leg 1 (+0.27..0.29). If ~0.1 lower -> drag (weed) -> cue clear_rudder. If higher -> current/wind strengthened along course.

t=676s: leg 3 (north) push_local +0.12 vs leg 1 +0.28: lower in BOTH directions, pod and HR steady -> drag, likely weed. Cued clear_rudder at ~676 s. Tell (finish 7000) still NOT delivered: send at >=737 s. Then check push_local recovery toward ~+0.28 on leg 3.

arguments.text: t=735s: RADIO escort ~720 s: wind filling in from the SOUTH 8-12 kn = tailwind on out/north (odd) legs, headwind on back/south (even) legs. Clear_rudder at 678: back-stroke NOT seen (paddler did not do it). measure: leg1 out GPS 3.36, leg2 back early 2.875, leg2 back late (after 530 s) 2.77, leg3 out still ramping (push_local 0.21->0.28 by 731 s). Hull fit share 0.676 stable. If leg-3 push_local settles ~0.35+ => wind only (no weed); if ~0.28 => wind plus drag. Wind-pacing gain (push harder into headwind) est. <2 s over race: not worth cues. HR flat at 168 W (trend ~0) => CP not lower than 167, maybe higher.

text: no cue: wind report noted; cue gate closed until 738 s, tell of new finish goes at 745 s wake

arguments.text: Course extended one leg. Finish now 7000 m, 4700 to go.

Race now 7000 m (radio 630 s), 7 legs of 1000 m; boat computer set to 7000, paddler told at 748 s (verify later with ask_paddler finish). Wind from south since ~530 s: tailwind on odd/north legs, headwind on even/south legs; push_local swings with it, NOT weed (leg 3 push_local 0.38 > leg 1 0.28). Pacer sets effort. Watch: (1) weed = push_local drop within a leg, compare with SAME-direction legs; (2) pod drift = pod power moves vs HR/GPS (eff_ratio ~0.68, hull-fit share 0.676); (3) CP check from HR at steady pod power (flat at 168-170 W so far); (4) radio and paddler talk. Do not waste cues.

t=1100s: paddler STILL thinks finish at 6000 (says 2600 to go at 3400 m) after 2 tells. Third tell blocked by gate; resend ~1125 s. POD DRIFT SUSPECT: pod fell 172 -> 146 W from ~1030 to 1094 s (smooth ramp) while GPS speed 2.556 -> 2.534 only (-1 %), HR 171.6 -> 170.2, rate 59.3 steady. A real 15 % ease would cut speed ~5 %. Estimate pod gain ~0.87 and still falling at 1094. Confirm then set_belief pod_gain (since ~1030, ramp).

arguments.name: pod_gain
arguments.evidence: pod reading fell smoothly 172 -> 132 W from ~1020 to 1135 s while GPS speed held 2.55, HR 170-172, rate 59 on the same leg: true effort ~170 W, so the pod reads ~0.76 of it and was still falling at 1135

arguments.text: t=1135s: set pod_gain 0.76 (since 1020, ramp 115 s). Pod drift was still FALLING at ~0.0023 per s at 1135: re-check corrected shaft_power_w vs HR/GPS every ~60 s and update pod_gain (if corrected power keeps dropping with HR/GPS steady, lower gain further). Third tell spoken at 1133 s (3505 to go); verify with ask_paddler finish.

arguments.reason: re-check pod drift (corrected shaft power vs HR, GPS) and update pod_gain; ask_paddler finish

text: set pod_gain 0.76: pod drifting low while speed and heart rate hold; told finish 7000 m again

arguments.name: pod_gain
arguments.evidence: raw pod 30-s mean fell 172 -> 124 W from ~1020 to 1184 s, flattening (only -4 W over the last 40 s); GPS 2.55-2.52 and HR 171-172 on the same headwind leg say true effort about 162-170 W

arguments.text: t=1190s: pod_gain refined to 0.75 (since 1020, ramp 150); raw ~124 W flattening; corrected ~164 W; pod reserve now 58 %. push_drop alert at 1178 = artefact of the gain correction (GPS 2.52-2.55 steady, HR 171), not weed. Paddler STILL thinks finish at ~6000 (says 2350 to go at 3650 m) after 3 spoken tells (750, 986, 1136). Paddler also ignored my clear_rudder at 678 and pacer rate_down at 1064: low cue compliance? Keep re-telling 7000 m, maybe say one more turn / extra leg.

arguments.text: t=1198s: pacer cued clear_rudder at 1196 - triggered by the push_local step my pod_gain correction caused (corrected power up -> predicted speed up -> push_local down), not by weed. Lesson: avoid large sudden pod_gain changes mid-leg. Next cue >=1256: re-tell finish 7000.

t=1270s: 4th tell spoken (3165 to go). Paddler says effort 3/10, plenty left (evidence only). HR trend ~0 at ~170 W true for 10 min (170 bpm leg 3, 171 leg 4) => at/below CP; CP may be higher than 167. test_cost +10 % 180 s: -5.5 s as calibrated (reserve otherwise left unspent: 4.7 kJ at finish), +0.2 s if CP 10 % lower => a piece is nearly free and tests CP (HR keeps climbing = above CP; levels = below). Hull fit share 0.626 with wind (was 0.676 pre-wind; wind asymmetry or slight overcorrection; HR says gain 0.75 ok). Plan: ask finish ~1300 s; piece +10 % ~200 s at >=1330 s.

arguments.text: Test piece: lift effort ten percent, three and a half minutes.

t=1340s: PIECE started: +10 % for 210 s (to ~1555 s) on leg 5 (north, tailwind). Baseline before: corrected pod ~168 W, HR 172-173, GPS 2.55 on leg 4. Read: corrected pod ~185 W if followed; HR after the first ~60-90 s: keeps climbing (>1.5 bpm/min) => above CP (CP ~167-180); levels => CP >= ~185, then chain more pieces to spend reserve. Compare with measure() windows 1340-1420 vs 1420-1550.

no cue: piece followed (corrected pod 188 W, raw 141), heart rate 173 so far; reading the result at 1561 s

arguments.text: Boat is clean, speed holding. Heavy feel is the piece.

7000 m race (paddler knows since 1315 s). Wind from south ~0.44 m/s push: legs 5 and 7 north = tailwind, leg 6 (5000-6000 m) south = headwind. Pod drift corrected (pod_gain 0.75 since 1020). CP test piece 1342-1567 at +10 % (186 W): HR rose ~1 bpm/min, paddler 5/10 and felt heavy => CP probably 167-185, not far above test. Pod reserve 29 % at 1561 (below the pacer 40 % finish threshold, so the pacer will NOT push at the finish): I must spend it. Plan: leg 6 headwind piece +4 % for ~380 s from ~1640 s (a joule buys ~40 % more time into the headwind); at 1000 m to go decide a final piece for leg 7 from HR, reserve and how they feel. No weed: paddler said heavy at 1561 but push_local and GPS steady.

arguments.reason: after the turn: start headwind piece +4 % for ~380 s on leg 6 (gate opens ~1640)
decide final piece for leg 7 (tailwind) to spend the remaining reserve

text: reassured the paddler: they feel heavy but speed and local push hold, so no weed and no back-stroke needed; headwind piece next

arguments.text: Headwind leg: lift five percent to the turn. Worth more here.

t=1648s: headwind piece +5 % (300 s + 80 s, to ~2030 s) from corrected pod 165 W -> ~173 W = computer sustainable 173 W. Reserve pod 28 % at CP 167 (7 % if CP 165, 96 % if 185). HR 177 just after the +10 % piece. Watch HR: if it climbs past ~182 steadily or paddler says cooked, CP is low - stop pushing. At 1000 m to go: final leg (tailwind) decision.

arguments.reason: mid headwind piece: check piece followed, HR trend, pod drift
